Name: Adrammelech, Son of Sennacherib
Summary: Adrammelech, son of Sennacherib, with his brother Sharezer, slew his father as he worshipped in the house of Nisroch, and escaped to Armenia.
RelatedPeople: Sennacherib, King of Assyria; Sharezer, Son of Sennacherib
LifeLesson: The king who mocked the living God was murdered by his own sons in his god's house.
